items.titleIt: Al memo di Henry Welles Livingston
items.excerpt:
A gentle spirit now above
Once animated what lies here
Till heav'n announc'd in tenderest love
"Ascend Immortal to yon sphere."
The lambkin at the great behest
Gave up its life without one groan;
When lo! In robes supernal drest
He found the bright abodes his own!
Most glorious and delightful scenes
Rush'd full upon his raptur'd sense;

La letteratura contemporanea africana esplora questi temi per affrontare questioni complesse.
items.titleIt: Spettri e realtà: sul mondo degli spiriti nella letteratura africana
items.excerpt: Across many African literary traditions, the boundaries between the living and the dead, the seen and the unseen, are fluid rather than fixed.
